subject: history
concept: Understanding civil rights movements and their fight for equal treatment under the law
source_inspiration: original content, presented factually per the Education Conduct Policy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines age-appropriate accounts of a civil rights movement's methods (peaceful protest, organizing, legal challenges)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a civil rights method to the change it helped bring about
exercise.abstract: Student explains one goal and one method of a studied civil rights movement

misconception_flags: cannot name any specific method or concrete goal of the studied movement

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
